record.paper: On the Complexity of Digraph Colourings and Vertex Arboricity

dossier_meta.paper: On the Complexity of Digraph Colourings and Vertex Arboricity
dossier_meta.statement_text: Let $F$ be a fixed (multi-)digraph. Instance: A (multi-)digraph $D$. Decide whether $D$ is circularly $F$-colourable.
dossier_meta.context_text: A digraph $D$ is circularly $F$-colourable if there exists a circular homomorphism from $D$ to $F$. This problem generalises Problem 1 and serves as a directed analogue of the $H$-colouring problem for graphs. Conjecture 2.16 asserts that NP-completeness holds whenever $F$ contains a directed cycle, and Theorem 2.17 establishes this for almost all such cases.
